title: Guide progression steps, tips and controls data; the Guide's 'Help' advice
player_outcome: The Guide's 'Help' button now gives context-aware advice about what to do next ('You should build a house...', 'Try crafting a Suspicious Looking Eye...'). The same steps feed the book's progression checklist.
design: New content category 'guideSteps' (GuideStepDef: Id, Name, Text, Order, After (step ids), TypedSpec[] DoneWhen, TypedSpec[] ShowWhen, RelatedItems, RelatedEnemies, Stage (pre_hardmode|hardmode|post_moon_lord)). New category 'guideTips' (GuideTipDef: Id, Name, Text with {key:action} placeholders, Topic (controls|building|combat|town|exploration), Action (input action name for the controls list)).

New Gameplay/Guide/ProgressionAdvisor.cs: Steps(ctx) → (step, done, available), and Next(ctx, n) → the first available undone steps by order. ctx is TownContext plus Records from the journal, so DoneWhen can use flags, killed, obtained, housed and similar.
A new 'advice' service replaces the Guide's one-line help. TownDialog.Services 'advice' shows Next(1).Text, and the Guide gets services [advice, craftHelp].

Data: data/guide/steps.json with about 30 steps (Terraria progression: shelter before night, Work Bench, house for the Guide, copper→iron gear, Life Crystals, EoC, evil boss, Goblin Army, Queen Bee, Skeletron and the Dungeon, Hellstone, WoF, altars, mechs, Plantera, Golem, Cultist, Pillars, Moon Lord). data/guide/tips.json with about 40 tips including a controls list (use_primary, jump, interact, inventory, grapple, map, guide_book, toggle_camera...). Validation lives in ContentValidator.Guide.cs.
data_changes: about 30 steps, about 40 tips; manifest regenerated
tests: ProgressionAdvisorTests: a new world's next step is 'build shelter/work bench'; after flag defeated_eye_of_cthulhu the EoC step is done and the next step is evil-boss related; an After cycle is rejected by the validator
Smoke town.cmds: 'ui talk guide' / 'ui service advice' / 'ui close'
verification: dotnet test; validate; in game the Guide's Help text changes as flags are set with the 'flag' command
risks: The step text needs careful Terraria-flavoured wording; keep it in data so it is easy to iterate.
